feeds.title: Champagne Days
feeds.description: A blog about the journey of IVF, motherhood, mayhem, and everything else in between and beyond. The confessions and chronicles of my life where madness and motherhood are not mutually exclusive. Many of these posts (especially those that relate to the IVF days) lay dormant on my laptop for a couple of years before I had the courage (and the motivation) to put Champagne Days together. I made the commitment to myself that if I was going to do this then I would do need to be confident to show my vulnerability and to be authentic and brave enough to tell it like it is.
